items.subject: Ops: test-auditors pre-push leg still loses the ref race when a rebase moves an input
evidence: queue body: push-main's outer gate ran run-gates only, so the full test-auditors leg (389 s) ran INSIDE the push lock on the landing f0d65b0d8, holding every other push on the box; plain git pushes 2, 4 and 5 each passed test-auditors in 422 to 451 s and lost the ref

ops/hooks/pre-push runs ops/prepush-test-auditors.ps1 -RefsFromStdin after run-gates; that script records a PASS keyed on its inputs' content (Get-TaInputKey, per checkout root) and prints REUSED key=... on a later run whose inputs did not move. push-main never ran it before taking the lock, so no pass was ever recorded for the in-lock run to reuse.

surface_fix.what: push-main's gate outside the lock runs both hook legs
surface_fix.exact_change: new Invoke-TcWarmTestAuditors (runs prepush-test-auditors -RefsFromStdin with the ref line git will hand the hook, 'HEAD <head> refs/heads/<branch> <remote sha>', exit 1 refuses before the lock, 3 degrades to the hook, exit 0 counts only with the COMPLETE marker) and Get-TcWarmRefLine; the default gate runner runs it after run-gates passes, and the refusal line names which leg refused

items.root_cause: the push-lock work moved run-gates out of the lock but not the hook's second leg, so the slowest gate still ran serialised
items.root_fix_none_because: the surface fix is the class fix: both hook legs now run outside the lock with the same inputs the hook will see, and the in-lock run is a reuse whenever the in-lock rebase brought no test-auditors input

blast_radius.measured_by: no matching rule or board input changed; push-main's own behaviour only
blast_radius.risk: a push-main run now pays the test-auditors leg outside the lock (where it was paid inside before); a red test-auditors check now refuses before queueing instead of after taking the lock

items.rollback: revert the push-main hunk; the hook is unchanged
items.resolution_note: push-main now runs prepush-test-auditors outside the lock after run-gates, with the hook's own ref line, so the in-lock leg reuses the recorded pass unless the in-lock rebase moved an input. A moved input still runs the whole leg inside the lock, by design: that content has not been judged.

items.subject: Baker's ad list: brand-only offers of tracked goods are unrouted
evidence: the router already tries headline AND body: grocery/pull-bakers-ad-list.ps1 routes every phrase from Get-BkalPhrases (headline, and headline plus body) through match-lib Resolve-Commodity; the unrouted[] rows carry both, e.g. 'Pepsi' + '12-Pack, 12 fl oz Cans', 'Tide Laundry Detergent' + 'Select Varieties, 117-132 fl oz'. So 'route through the full matcher including body text' is what already runs.

router-only alternative measured 2026-09-18 before 16:52: infer an offer's commodity from the store's OWN catalogue, i.e. route every captured Baker's product name (out\regular\bakers-regular-*.json, last 20 files, 7,190 distinct names) that starts with the offer's brand and take the majority. Of 79 unrouted offers, 16 had any such name: right for Pepsi (soda 7 of 7), 7UP (soda 1), Big K (soda 8 of 10), Doritos (tortilla-chips 2), Barefoot/Apothic/Kendall-Jackson (wine); WRONG for Smucker's Uncrustables (peanut-butter 1 of 1), Kroger Cheese (cheese-tortellini 2, frozen-pizza 1), Carving Pumpkins (apples 8 of 11), Ken's or Kraft Salad Dressing (split over 3 dressings); 0 names at all for Tide, Swanson, Progresso, Dasani, because nobody asks those terms. The named residual is not reachable from the router.
items.root_cause: the catalogue includes name kinds of product, not brands, so a brand-only offer headline has no include to hit; the matcher correctly does not guess
items.resolution_note: MONEY-LANE HAND-BACK: the fix is catalogue data (brand tokens on soda, laundry detergent, chips, broth, canned soup, bottled water includes in commodities.json), a matching-rule change on this lane's line. Router-level inference measured and rejected: 16 of 79 offers reachable, at least 4 of those wrong, and 0 of Tide/Swanson/Progresso/Dasani.
